entities.summary: Nikos Pappas is a Greek economist and politician who serves as parliamentary representative of Syriza. He also served as Minister of Digital Policy, Telecommunications and Media in Alexis Tsipras' second cabinet. He represents the Athens B constituency in the Hellenic Parliament.
